description:
STABLE THREE-WHEEL DESIGN - The three-wheel structure provides enhanced balance and stability for daily transportation, neighborhood trips, shopping, and recreational riding. The low step-through platform makes getting on and off easier for adult riders.

650W BRUSHLESS MOTOR - Powered by a 650W brushless motor with up to 1000W peak output, this electric tricycle reaches speeds of up to 12.4 MPH and handles climbing angles up to 15 degrees under suitable riding conditions.

48V 13.5AH LONG-RANGE BATTERY - The high-capacity lithium battery supports a maximum riding range of up to 30 miles per charge. Actual range may vary depending on rider and cargo weight, speed, terrain, incline, temperature, and riding habits.

DUAL BASKETS FOR CARGO & PETS - The spacious front basket provides room for groceries, bags, or a properly secured pet, while the large rear basket carries additional everyday essentials. The reinforced frame supports a total maximum load of up to 300 pounds.

COMFORTABLE & COMMUTER-READY - A wide padded seat with supportive backrest, ergonomic handlebars, suspension components, and 12-inch pneumatic tires help provide a smoother ride. The tricycle also features a headlight, disc braking system, fenders, bell, IPX4 water-resistant construction, and convenient parking support.
